rewards.name: step_marker_density
rewards.description: Rewards moderate density of step markers (0.5-2.0 per 10 words). Too few steps get 0.0, too many get -1.0. Encourages structured but not over-structured reasoning.

rewards.name: verification_step_detection
rewards.description: Rewards explicit verification steps in the thinking section. Correct answers with 2+ verification mentions get 5.0, 1 gets 4.0, 0 gets 3.0. Incorrect answers are penalized more for lacking verification.

rewards.name: bigram_repetition_penalty
rewards.code:
def bigram_repetition_penalty(prompts, completions, answer, **kwargs):
    out = []
    for c in completions:
        words = c[0]["content"].lower().split()
        if len(words) < 2:
            out.append(0.0)
            continue
        grams = list(zip(words, words[1:]))
        unique_ratio = len(set(grams)) / len(grams)
        penalty = -(1.0 - unique_ratio) * 2.0
        out.append(penalty)
    return out
rewards.description: Penalizes bigram repetition. Score ranges from 0 (all unique) to -2.0 (all repeated). Encourages diverse, non-looping reasoning.

rewards.name: mistake_correction_detection
rewards.description: Rewards self-correction behavior. Correct answers with corrections get 5.0, without get 4.0. Incorrect answers with multiple corrections get -0.5 (showing effort), without get -1.5.

rewards.name: sentence_length_variability
rewards.description: Rewards moderate sentence lengths (5-25 words average). Very long sentences (>40 words) get -1.5, indicating rambling. Very short get -0.5.

rewards.name: truncation_and_tag_balance
rewards.description: Penalizes unbalanced tags (opening without closing) and text that appears truncated. Balanced tags get 1.0, unbalanced get -2.0, truncation adds -0.5.

rewards.name: unique_answer_cluster_size
rewards.description: Rewards being in a large correct cluster (up to 5.0) and penalizes being in a large incorrect cluster (down to -2.0). Encourages convergence on correct answers.

candidates.name: numeric_relative_error
candidates.description: Gives partial credit based on relative numerical error. Correct answers get 5.0. Near misses (<1% error) get 3.0, moderate misses (<10%) get 1.0, large misses get negative scores. Handles fractions, decimals, and simple expressions.

candidates.name: answer_format_consistency
candidates.description: Penalizes format mismatches between predicted and ground truth answers. Correct answers get 5.0. Incorrect answers with matching format get -0.5, mismatched format gets -1.5, missing answer gets -2.0.

candidates.name: missing_solution_tag_penalty
candidates.description: Rewards proper use of <solution> tags. Correct answers with both tags get 5.0, one tag gets 4.0, no tags gets 3.0. Incorrect answers are penalized more severely for missing tags.

candidates.name: group_length_rank_correct
candidates.description: Among correct answers in a group, shorter ones get higher scores (5.0 for shortest, 3.0 for longest). Incorrect answers get -1.0. Encodes efficiency within correctness.

candidates.name: thinking_to_solution_ratio
candidates.description: Rewards a balanced ratio of thinking to solution length (30-80% thinking). Correct answers with good balance get 5.0. Incorrect answers with extreme ratios get heavier penalties.

candidates.name: solution_length_cap
candidates.description: Penalizes overly long solution sections. Correct answers under 500 chars get 5.0, longer get decreasing scores. Incorrect answers with very short solutions get -1.0, longer get -2.0.

candidates.name: majority_agreement_bonus
candidates.description: Rewards agreement with the majority answer in the group. Correct majority answers get 5.0, incorrect majority gets 2-4 based on majority size, correct minority gets 3.0, incorrect minority gets -1.0.

candidates.name: group_disagreement_penalty
candidates.description: When a group has mixed correctness, correct answers get 4.0 and incorrect get -2.0, creating strong separation. All-correct groups get 5.0, all-incorrect get -1.0.

candidates.name: unique_answer_cluster_size
candidates.description: Rewards being in a large correct cluster (up to 5.0) and penalizes being in a large incorrect cluster (down to -2.0). Encourages convergence on correct answers.

candidates.name: unit_consistency_check
candidates.description: Checks unit consistency between predicted and ground truth answers. Missing units when expected get -1.0, wrong units get -1.5, matching units get +0.5. Correct answers get 5.0.
